chapter: Benny Goodman and first US jobs
title: Roy Eldridge, jamming and socializing after concerts
summary: Eldridge wanted to jam and meet people after every concert.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: In the jazz, you know, [inaudible]. I was with Artie Shaw, if you remember.

Oh, yeah. That sound. And he wanted to jam all the time. After each engagement, he mostly wanted to meet ladies after the concert, you know. Say we play in a town in Oslo, for instance. After the concert, he goes to the jazz club or something. He wanted to socialize, also. [laughs] And jam. Of course.
Uh-huh. Did you go with him? [laughs]
